name: target-fir-ground-coverage-shadows-on
review_note: Targets fir_3.mesh lod_0 -> fir_branch at (12.19,-55.59,15.42), above ground at z~13.1. SceneBuilder routes its alpha-tested fir material to a separate coverage-modulated shadow caster; the color-pass tree is unchanged. At hour10 the sun casts the canopy shadow southwest onto the framed ground. Disable regular and massive grass in BOTH halves because opaque foreground blades hide that receiver; leave the tree, sun, AO and all shadow mechanisms otherwise configured normally. Pose is derived from authored geometry/world transforms; first capture must confirm unobstructed framing. Each pair changes only features.transparent_shadows.

name: target-lamp-receiver-ssgi-on
review_note: Frames warm authored lamp illumination against the neighboring street/wall receiver. SSGI gathers color from the PREVIOUS completed scene-color capture within a 3.5%-screen-space radius, so this closer receiver gives local color/depth structure instead of the distant airship silhouette. High sample quality, 180 fixed frames. Disable heat haze in BOTH halves to prevent its alternate scene-capture owner from withholding fresh SSGI history; disable bloom/lens flares in both to distinguish color bleeding from a glow sprite. No light colors, material routes or SSGI intensity changed. Pose is derived from authored geometry/world transforms; first capture must confirm unobstructed framing. Each pair changes only features.ssgi.
